title: Harichandra
desc: A compulsive liar falls in love with an honest school principal. However, his habit of lying starts causing problems in their relationship.

title: Kai Koduppal Karpagambal
desc: Dr Rajeshwari, an ardent devotee of Goddess Karpagambal, lands in trouble when she is imprisoned due to a false charge. However, her profound faith in the goddess helps her battle difficult times.

title: Vande Mataram
desc: When several efforts made by officials to improve the welfare of farmers are jeopardised due to terrorist activities, two police officers attempt to combat the threat.

title: Alli Thandha Vaanam
desc: An entrepreneur challenges his reckless son, Satyam, to live independently for three months. Satyam's varied encounters end up changing him as a human being.

title: Priyamaanavale
desc: Vijay gets married to Priya at his father's behest, but on the condition that at the end of the year he will get to decide whether he wants to continue their marriage or terminate it.
